# Amazon ML Challenge 2026 Explorer — Historical Archive

> "Amazon ML Challenge 2026 — The Competition, Preserved."
> Official Explorer Domain: https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/

## Project Overview
Amazon ML Challenge Explorer is an independent historical archive, leaderboard analysis platform, and institutional benchmarking system for the Amazon ML Challenge 2026 machine learning competition.

The competition has concluded. This platform preserves 10,942 registered student teams, 36,016 participants, 2,663 participating academic institutions, and 17 chronological leaderboard checkpoints captured between September 26 and September 28, 2026.

## Key Datasets & Scope
- **Final Submitting Teams:** 4,334 teams with benchmark F1 scores on the final recorded leaderboard.
- **Top F1 Score Recorded:** 0.985388
- **Median Competitive Score:** 0.684120
- **Academic Organizations:** 2,663 distinct engineering colleges, universities, and technical institutes across India.
- **Multi-College Collaborations:** 3,993 teams with cross-institutional rosters.
- **Historical Snapshots:** 17 sequential checkpoints preserving intermediate leaderboard states and rank displacements.

## Key Exploration Routes
- **Homepage:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/ — Overview, quick search, featured teams, statistics summary.
- **Final Leaderboard:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/leaderboard — Comprehensive 4,334 team standings, F1 scores, team sizes, and search.
- **Movers & Climbers Dashboard:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/movers — Step-by-step checkpoint comparison across all 16 intervals tracking top climbers, score gainers, and displacements.
- **Colleges Directory:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/colleges — Searchable index of 2,663 participating academic institutions.
- **College Leaderboard:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/colleges/leaderboard — Multi-metric institutional rankings by top finishes, median score, and team volume.
- **Competition Statistics:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/statistics — Aggregations, score distributions, team size histograms, and participation analytics.
- **Editorial Blog & Insights:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/blog — Research articles, leaderboard dynamics, and competition breakdowns.
- **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ):** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/faq — Knowledge base answering common competition and platform questions.
- **Methodology & Calculations:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/methodology — Technical documentation on snapshot processing and ranking math.
- **Data Policy & Disclaimer:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/data-policy — Archive transparency, student privacy protection, and non-affiliation statements.
- **Support & Feedback:** https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app/support — Community support via Ko-fi and feedback link.


## Data Methodology & Limitations
- **Immutability:** Dataset is fixed to the recorded competition timeframe.
- **Evaluation Metric:** Micro F1 Score on multimodal attribute extraction.
- **Rank Delta Math:** Rank Movement = (Previous Rank) - (Current Rank).
- **Independence:** Not officially affiliated with or sponsored by Amazon. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
